prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic vertical Korean webtoon/manhwa action page about a young swordsman performing an elegant martial arts demonstration in a crowded historical courtyard.

Canvas: Tall vertical comic page, smartphone webtoon aspect ratio around 9:21, full-bleed art with thin white diagonal panel gutters. Cinematic anime/manhwa rendering, highly detailed linework, soft painterly shading, dynamic motion blur, bright daylight, blue sky with scattered clouds.

Layout: Use exactly 8 stacked diagonal comic panels.
1. Top establishing panel: a wide shot of a traditional Joseon-era courtyard surrounded by tiled wooden buildings, banners, and a large crowd viewed from behind; the young swordsman in flowing white robes leaps or spins at center, long black hair trailing, surrounded by sweeping white ribbon-like sword energy.
2. Action close-up panel: the swordsman in white robes cuts across the frame in midair, intense eyes, loose black hair, dark blue inner garment and sash, circular crest on the sleeve, translucent sleeves and white energy arcs slicing diagonally through the composition; blurred spectators behind him.
3. Crowd reaction panel: four prominent male spectators in simple period clothing and headbands look upward in amazement, with many more faces behind them; expressions include shock, wonder, open mouths, and raised brows.
4. Quiet tension panel: close side profile of the same young man now in a black outer robe, damp tousled black hair falling over sharp eyes, serious expression, crowd and courtyard blurred in the background.
5. Wide action panel: back and side view of the swordsman in white robes twisting through a powerful slash, robe fabric flaring, dark sash visible, long hair whipping, white motion ribbons crossing the foreground, crowd watching behind.
6. Close-up dialogue panel: intense front three-quarter close-up of the young man in black robe, pale skin, sharp gray eyes, messy black bangs, focused and restrained expression; add one white oval speech bubble on the left containing the Korean text 아니..
7. Action close-up panel: the swordsman in white robes extends his arm in a decisive slash, face partially turned toward the viewer, hair streaming, sleeve and white energy streaks sweeping from left to right, spectators blurred behind.
8. Final reaction/dialogue panel: the young man in black robe stands among stunned spectators, looking to the side with alert disbelief; add one white oval speech bubble on the right containing the Korean text 거기서 허리를 틀면 힘이 끊기잖아..

Subject details: The main character is a beautiful, serious young East Asian male with long messy black hair, sharp narrow eyes, pale skin, athletic build, and a composed but intense expression. His martial arts outfit alternates between a flowing white hanbok-style robe with navy inner layers and a black robe in the dialogue panels. The crowd consists of dozens of Joseon-era townspeople and trainees in muted brown, gray, and navy garments with cloth headbands.

Visual style: High-end Korean fantasy manhwa, semi-realistic anime faces, intricate clothing folds, dramatic perspective, diagonal speed lines, luminous white sword wind effects, shallow depth of field, detailed historical architecture, expressive crowd reactions, polished webtoon coloring.

Constraints: Keep exactly 8 panels and exactly 2 speech bubbles. Preserve the Korean speech bubble text exactly as written. Do not add extra captions, sound effects, logos, watermarks, or modern objects.
